concerns.text: T002 is tagged as covering FR-001 but fetches `matbench_expt_gap`, `matbench_mp_e_form`, and `boltztrap_mp` via matminer — none of which are the OQMD (Band Gap, Formation Energy) or AFLOW (Thermal Conductivity) sources FR-001/SC-005 mandate. As written, no task satisfies FR-001's named data sources; either the spec must be amended to name the matminer datasets or T002 must fetch OQMD/AFLOW.

T006 runs Wilcoxon on per-sample errors (`abs_error`), but `stats.schema.yaml` constrains `metric_type` to only `calibration_error` or `sharpness`. No task produces rows that both implement FR-004's per-sample-error pairing and validate against the contract T006 itself cites; the task and the contract it must conform to are incompatible.

Principle VII requires computational cost metrics to show statistically significant differences (paired tests) to claim superiority. T004 only records `cost_metrics.csv`; T006 tests only calibration/sharpness. No task covers paired significance testing of cost metrics — a coverage gap against a constitution requirement.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T002 vs contracts/dataset.schema.yaml and plan.md:Data-Model Mapping
concerns.text: The plan's data-model mapping assigns `download.py` → MaterialsDataset (`contracts/dataset.schema.yaml`), but no task writes an artifact conforming to that contract: T002 writes ad-hoc `<dataset_id>_metadata.json` with a different field set (no n_train/n_val/n_test/features/target). The dataset.schema.yaml contract and MaterialsDataset entity have no covering task.

T003's thin run uses 100 rows with a 15% test split (~15 test samples), while the spec assumes ≥100 test samples and the plan's power analysis requires ≥200. No task marks the thin run as exempt from this floor, so SC-001's 'completes on a subset of data' is covered only by a run that violates the stated statistical-validity assumption.
